evidence: line 102 [host]: Scale indexing must use floor division of the row and column by the block side.
note: Line 102 (scale_columns = N // TILE_SIZE) is host-side tile-count arithmetic and already uses floor division; it is not a scale index. The kernel's scale addressing is exact block floor division: row tile scale_row covers rows [scale_row*T, (scale_row+1)*T) (= row // T); partition lane (g, b) loads S[scale_row, c0//T + b] (S.ap pattern [[0, stripe_groups],[1, blocks]], offset scale_row*scale_cols + c0//T) for columns [c0+b*T, c0+(b+1)*T) (= col // T), matching the X/Y access patterns. No expanded scale map, no host-side multiply; one traversal of X and one write of Y on device.
